threshold_note: static threshold: percentile of the lead-shifted signal over the IS quarters
strategy_description: Long SPY when the 2-quarter-lagged ECI 2-quarter growth is at or below its threshold; otherwise cash. (Countercyclical orientation: low/decelerating wage inflation = risk-on.) Rebalanced quarterly.
lead_description: Signal lead = 2 quarter(s) (~6 months); L1 is the registry floor (BLS releases quarter Q's ECI ~1 month after quarter end)

selection.objective_formula: in-sample (common window [common_is_start, OOS start)) quarterly mean/std*sqrt(4) of position_t*spy_ret_t; winner evaluated on the OOS window with ECON-T4 deployable scoring (fillna 0)

is_window.rule: eligibility before alignment: a candidate is IS-eligible only if its own first valid return leaves >= 20 IS quarters; common_is_start = latest first-valid-return date among eligible candidates; IS metrics for every candidate computed on [common_is_start, oos_start)
is_window.validity: IS window only: is_n >= 20, IS exposure in [0.05, 0.95] (P3: share of quarters long), IS std > 0, IS turnover < 6/yr; OOS never consulted

selection.rationale: Winner is the IS-valid row with the highest IN-SAMPLE Sharpe (common IS window) over the floored quarterly grid L1..L5; OOS metrics are reported for that row only (no OOS look-ahead in selection). Regime signals (HMM, Markov-switching) are not in the grid: a causal IS-only fit needs >= 100 IS rows and ECI has 72 IS quarters.

legacy_oos_selected_row.note: OOS-argmax on this grid (pre-GH#251 rule), comparison only; see legacy_oos_selection_20261016.csv

sensitivity_own_is_start_row.note: IS argmax without common-start alignment; sensitivity only

previously_published.status: superseded: relied on full-sample, forward-backward smoothed HMM probabilities (look-ahead) and was selected by OOS Sharpe

inference.note: expected max |z| = Phi^-1(1 - 0.5/N) over N distinct position series (two-sided, independence approximation)

notes: Quarterly pair (annualization sqrt(4); leads/lookbacks/oos_n in quarters). 20261016 rerun: tournament of 1180 strategy combos (+1 benchmark), 1080 IS-valid. Winner selected by in-sample Sharpe on the common IS window 2008-12-31..2019-12-31 (45 quarters) and evaluated on the held-out OOS window 2020-03-31..2026-03-31 (25 quarters): IS Sharpe 1.19 (B&H 0.79), OOS Sharpe 0.70 (B&H 0.80), OOS HAC t 1.33. The HMM and Markov-switching regime signals are not in the grid: a causal (IS-only, forward-filtered) fit needs at least 100 IS rows and ECI has 72 IS quarters. The previously published winner (hmm_stress/T3_zscore_1.0/LB12/P1_long_cash_counter/L4q, OOS Sharpe 1.41) used full-sample smoothed HMM probabilities; the same rule on a causal diagnostic HMM scores 1.03 (hmm_lookahead_audit_20261016.json). Lead-lag (empirical): ECI->SPY TY-Granger sig lags(q) NONE, SPY->ECI [1, 2, 3, 4] -> 'lagging'. Gross of costs; sensitivity in tournament_validation_20261016/.
